## 解决的问题 / Problem

<!-- 触发条件、实际影响和关联 Issue（如有）。 Trigger, impact and related issue, if any. -->

## 改动后的行为 / Changes

<!-- 简述改动前后；UI 变化附脱敏截图及语言、主题、宽度。 Describe before/after; include redacted UI screenshots with language, theme and width when relevant. -->

## 验证 / Validation

<!-- 实际执行的命令、结果和未执行项。注明离线、模拟或真实上游。 Actual commands, results and skipped checks. Distinguish offline, mock and live-upstream tests. -->

## 兼容与来源 / Compatibility and provenance

<!-- 配置、数据、API 或行为变化；第三方代码/资产来源及许可证。无此类变化写“无 / None”。 Configuration, data, API or behavioral impact; provenance and licenses for third-party code/assets. Write “None” if not applicable. -->

- [ ] 改动范围集中，相关文档与翻译已同步。 / The change is focused; affected documentation and translations are updated.
- [ ] 提交已按贡献指南签署 DCO，新增材料的来源已核对。 / Commits are signed off as described in the contribution guide; new material has provenance.
- [ ] 已移除凭据及私人数据，并如实说明验证范围。 / Credentials and private data are removed; verification scope is accurately stated.
